thread:
matt: starting hands-off check for tonight's quiet window deploy at 00:30 UTC. This touches API (v2.1.0 -> v2.2.0), runtime kernel bump, console schema migration, and a router header split. tagging @cheng @alisha for handshake. Plan: staged canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation each. Rollback if p90 latency > 50ms or error rate > 0.5% during a window.

alisha: noted — I will pin runtime to kernel-4.8-compat for the canary nodes. Console migration is schema-v3, no backfill required. Router header swap needs a preflight on header routing table (esp. cookie fallback).

cheng: holding on the API pin until runtime confirms KV eviction safety. If eviction churn is high, we keep API pinned to v2.1.0 for the region. Also enabling router congestion guard for the header split.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: running preflight checks... capacity ok, autoscaler healthy, infra quotas clear. Locking provisional pins: API=v2.2.0, runtime=kernel-4.8-compat, console=schema-v3. Dry-run smoke tests passed (smoke: ok).

sarah: small heads-up — console telemetry historically spikes ~00:10 during previous night runs. Recommend we add +5m stabilization after canary ramp before 25% and before 100%.

matt: ack, adding +5m stabilization. Explicit rollback criteria: manual stop if p95 latency increases > 75ms OR sustained error rate > 1% for 2 consecutive mins. Automated fallback: steer traffic to stable router variant `router-stable-2026` if header swap triggers failures.

cheng: KV eviction thresholds set to conservative: max_live_shards=80%, eviction_window=30s. Runtime will keep previous KV cache for 2m on canary nodes to reduce cold-cache errors.

alisha: console will mute non-critical alerts during warmup window (to avoid noisy pages). Runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/deploy/quietwindow-pins (please ACK).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: wave 1 (canary) scheduled to start 00:30:00 UTC. Runbook acknowledged by: @matt @cheng @alisha. To abort: react with :no_entry_sign: or reply "hold" in this thread.

matt: placing a manual hold: hold for 10m to observe autoscaler heat-up metrics before releasing.

cheng: observability tweak applied: temporary dashboard filter `job=runtime-canary AND route=header-split`. I'll be on call if p90 > 60ms :phone: — paging channel if triggered.

sarah: LGTM from console side. If we need to revert, prefer traffic pin (router-level) over full service revert to minimize churn.

matt: final note — pin manifests saved at `infra/pins/2026-03-21/1748604321.json`. We'll re-open this thread after wave 1 for post-canary verification. Starting sequence in ~10m unless further holds.
